name: @composable/ui-workspace
description: Host site: the workspace shell starter, hosting @composable components at build time (in markup) and at runtime (in the dock).

scripts.build: bun scripts/prebuild.ts && bun build src/main.ts src/shared/*.ts --outdir public --root src --splitting --chunk-naming chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext] --format esm --minify --sourcemap=linked --loader .css:text && bun build src/sandbox/boot.ts --outdir public/sandbox --format esm --external '@pritzlaff/*' --external lit --external 'lit/*' --external typebox --external 'typebox/*'
scripts.dev: bun scripts/prebuild.ts && bun build src/sandbox/boot.ts --outdir public/sandbox --format esm --external '@pritzlaff/*' --external lit --external 'lit/*' --external typebox --external 'typebox/*' && bun build src/main.ts src/shared/*.ts --outdir public --root src --splitting --chunk-naming chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext] --format esm --sourcemap=linked --loader .css:text --watch
